meta.title: Codeissue — From idea to working product
meta.description: Codeissue designs and builds digital products using AI-assisted workflows, custom systems, and human review.

hero.lineOne: Every idea starts as an issue.
hero.lineTwo: We turn yours into a working product.
hero.description: Strategy, design, engineering, and review — one focused team from first note to working release.

ticket.title: Turn an idea into a product

approach.title: Your idea. Our next issue.
approach.description: We design and build digital products using AI-assisted workflows, custom systems, and human review.

principles.title: AI-assisted, not AI-shaped.
principles.copy: We use AI where it improves speed and coverage. Product decisions, taste, and accountability stay human.

principles.title: Built for the actual problem.
principles.copy: No generic stack pasted onto every brief. We shape the system around the product, constraints, and team.

principles.title: Reviewed before release.
principles.copy: Every important interaction, edge case, and implementation choice gets a deliberate human pass.

process.title: A clear path from thought to product.
process.description: We keep the process visible, reduce uncertainty early, and make each stage produce something you can review.

steps.title: Frame the issue.
steps.copy: We turn the idea into a precise problem, define the audience, and agree on what a useful first release must do.

steps.title: Design the system.
steps.copy: We map the experience, prototype the difficult parts, and create a visual system that supports the product instead of decorating it.

steps.title: Build the product.
steps.copy: Design and engineering move together. We implement the core, connect the systems, and keep the release usable at every checkpoint.

steps.title: Review and release.
steps.copy: We test real scenarios, resolve edge cases, document the handoff, and ship a release that can keep evolving.

services.title: Digital products that have to work.
services.description: From a focused launch page to a custom platform, we care about the same thing: a clear product that survives real use.

items.title: Web products
items.copy: Customer-facing platforms, dashboards, services, and responsive interfaces.

items.title: Internal systems
items.copy: Tools and workflows that remove repetitive work and make operations easier to understand.

items.title: AI-assisted features
items.copy: Useful AI inside a product — scoped, tested, observable, and always reviewable.

items.title: Product foundations
items.copy: Design systems, architecture, prototypes, and the groundwork for a reliable next release.

network.title: Follow the work, not the noise.
network.description: Product notes, build logs, source code, streams, and direct community updates.
